def VTask.binaryRec {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (zero : motive 0) (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) (n : ℕ) : motive n :=
  n.wf_rec (λ m ih => 
    match m with
    | 0 => zero
    | succ k => 
      let b : Bool := m % 2 == 1
      let n' : ℕ := m / 2
      bit b n' (ih n' (Nat.div_lt_of_pos m 2 (Nat.succ_ne_zero k) Nat.zero_lt_two))
  )
